description: Na₃SbF₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and two longer (2.26 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.18 Å) and two longer (2.25 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.29 Å) and two longer (2.33 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Sb is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are two shorter (2.22 Å) and four longer (2.25 Å) Sb-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one Sb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Sb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Sb atom.
